description_en: Queries all ports used by domain names of the current user. Only domain names with CNAME access and hybrid cloud CNAME domain names with public network disaster recovery enabled are included
description_zh: 查用户所有域名使用的端口，只包含CNAME接入的域名和混合云CNAME域名开启公网容灾的域名
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain-used-ports --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainUsedPorts
